# Zizeg

> Preview and Source. Both editable. Zizeg is a native macOS Markdown editor for working visually, directly in Markdown, or with both editors side by side.

Zizeg edits ordinary `.md` files directly on disk. Its rendered Preview and Markdown Source are equal editing surfaces: users can edit either one separately or keep both visible in Split view, where changes stay synchronized. The same toolbar, menus, and keyboard shortcuts work in both editors. Preview and Source can also use independent typography and independent or synchronized scrolling.

Zizeg follows native macOS document conventions, including standard document tabs, menus, toolbar controls, autosave, and Finder-based files. It does not require a vault, library, import step, proprietary database, or proprietary document format.

Language availability: English, Hungarian, German, French, Spanish (Spain), and Spanish (Mexico). Choose the app interface language in Zizeg Preferences; the built-in Help follows the Mac language setting.

The app is designed for everyday Markdown work, including READMEs, instruction files, specifications, plans, changelogs, and summaries created during AI-assisted workflows. Zizeg itself does not use AI or send documents to an AI service.

Safety checks do not silently rewrite the saved Markdown. Sanitization happens during rendering and export, remote images remain blocked until the user approves them, and unsafe or unsupported content is visibly flagged. Pasted images can be stored in a sibling assets folder or embedded for single-file portability. Zizeg can export self-contained HTML and multi-page PDF.

Markdown support covers CommonMark and GitHub Flavored Markdown, including headings, lists, task lists, tables, strikethrough, autolinks, code, quotes, links, and images. It does not currently include math/LaTeX, footnotes, or Mermaid diagrams.

## Availability and pricing

Zizeg is available now on the Mac App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/zizeg/id6800761262?mt=12. Opening and viewing Markdown is free. Editing and export can be unlocked with a USD lifetime purchase of $14.99, a 12-month subscription of $9.99, or a 3-month subscription of $2.99. Both subscriptions include a 7-day free trial. Final App Store prices vary by region.

App Store availability updated: 2026-09-23. Other product details last reviewed: 2026-09-05.

- [Markdown guides](https://zizeg.app/guides/): Practical guides to reading and working with Markdown on a Mac.
- [Open and read Markdown files on Mac](https://zizeg.app/guides/open-markdown-files-on-mac/): What .md files are, plain-text and formatted reading, opening files in Zizeg, default viewing modes, and swapping Split panes.
- [Change the default Markdown app on Mac](https://zizeg.app/guides/change-default-markdown-app-mac/): Finder file associations, Zizeg’s default-app shortcut, and default viewing modes.
- [Edit Markdown without a vault](https://zizeg.app/guides/edit-markdown-without-vault/): Open and edit standalone files in place, use autosave and Save As, and keep documents and images together.
- [Editable Markdown preview or split preview: what is the difference?](https://zizeg.app/guides/editable-markdown-preview-vs-split-view/): Compare four models: source alone, source with read-only preview, editable rendered view alone, and source with editable Preview.
- [Looking for a native Mac alternative to Typora? Start with your workflow](https://zizeg.app/guides/native-mac-typora-alternative/): Try editable Preview and Source, Mac-native controls, a heading outline, row numbers, and one-time or subscription editing access.
- [How to edit Markdown tables without counting pipes](https://zizeg.app/guides/edit-markdown-tables-visually/): Build a table, edit cells, change rows and columns, and set alignment while keeping Markdown source.
- [How to export Markdown to PDF on a Mac](https://zizeg.app/guides/markdown-to-pdf-mac/): Create a paginated PDF, choose paper size, and check tables, images, and metadata before sending.
- [Share Markdown as one standalone HTML file](https://zizeg.app/guides/markdown-to-standalone-html/): Package rendered Markdown and its images into one browser-readable HTML file.
- [Should you send Markdown, PDF or HTML?](https://zizeg.app/guides/share-markdown-pdf-or-html/): Choose an editable source, fixed-page PDF, or browser-readable HTML using real recipient scenarios.
- [Why do Markdown images disappear after moving the file?](https://zizeg.app/guides/fix-markdown-images-after-moving-file/): Repair relative image paths, replace missing pictures, and keep a document with its assets.
- [How to add screenshots and images to a Markdown document on Mac](https://zizeg.app/guides/add-screenshots-to-markdown-mac/): Paste screenshots, insert image files, add alt text, and understand the companion assets folder.
- [Markdown images: separate files or Base64 embedding?](https://zizeg.app/guides/markdown-images-files-vs-base64/): Compare separate image files with Base64 in Markdown, using measured sample sizes. Choose a storage format and convert a copy with Zizeg Save As.
- [Why are online images missing from my Markdown preview?](https://zizeg.app/guides/markdown-remote-images-not-loading/): Fix missing online Markdown images on Mac. Distinguish blocked content from a broken URL, check Zizeg remote-image settings, and verify exported pictures.
- [Mac App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/zizeg/id6800761262?mt=12): Zizeg's official download page.
- [Markdown editor comparison](https://zizeg.app/compare): A workflow-focused comparison with Clearly, Typora, Obsidian, iA Writer, and Ferrite. Includes methodology and links to vendor documentation.
